title: Environmental infraction notices of the city of Recife, Brazil

source.license_note: ODbL (Dados Recife, the open data portal of the city of Recife)

series.name: notices
series.description: Number of environmental infraction notices of the month, dated by the inspection that originated them

domain: The Secretariat of Environment and Sustainability of the city of Recife (Secretaria de Meio Ambiente e Sustentabilidade) publishes the environmental infraction notices (autos de infração ambiental) it issues under municipal environmental law to people, companies and properties, one file per year. Each record is one notice, dated by the inspection (vistoria) that originated it. Only 2021 to 2023 are published, so the series is short: 36 months, the minimum the detectors accept.

categories.PDC: Policy-Driven Change: legislation, regulation, agency restructuring or political transition
categories.SP: Seasonal Pattern: a recurring annual inspection cycle
categories.DQE: Data-Quality Event: reporting failure, system migration, backlog, duplication or retroactive correction
categories.GES: Genuine Enforcement Shift: a real change in inspection or enforcement intensity not explained by the above
